title: Zaalouk Eggplant Stew
description: A rich and flavorful Moroccan stew made with eggplant, tomatoes, and spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the eggplant and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in the zaalouk spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of water and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the eggplant is very tender, about 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
